corrective_action: Develop standardized Green ICT KPIs for all major operators.
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 11.11(a)-(d); Renewable Energy Policy 2025
evidence_basis: Operators use different indicators units baselines and reporting levels for Green ICT performance.

corrective_action: Require standardized operator-level disclosure of GHG emissions and e-waste information.
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 11.11(c)-(d); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Section 14.3
evidence_basis: Operator-level GHG and e-waste information is incomplete or reported using different scopes measures and classifications.

corrective_action: Strengthen network energy-efficiency measures and improve energy-demand management.
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 11.11(a) and 11.11(d)
evidence_basis: Energy demand and associated emissions remain important environmental concerns despite existing efficiency measures.

corrective_action: Expand solar and hybrid renewable-energy systems where technically feasible.
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(b); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Sections 5.1.3-5.1.4
evidence_basis: Physical renewable-energy deployment remains limited or uneven across network sites.
responsible_actor: Mobile operators and relevant energy-sector authorities

corrective_action: Complete and operationalize CPPA and related regulatory mechanisms.
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 11.11(b) and 11.12; Renewable Energy Policy 2025
evidence_basis: Renewable electricity procurement can be constrained by regulatory contractual and implementation mechanisms.
responsible_actor: BTRC government and relevant energy-sector authorities

corrective_action: Introduce measurable reporting requirements for tower fibre and other infrastructure sharing.
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 5.3 7.2.8 7.7 and 13.6
evidence_basis: Insufficient quantitative operator-level evidence is available to assess infrastructure-sharing coverage and resource-efficiency benefits.

corrective_action: Assign clear responsibilities and improve monitoring coordination and accountability.
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 11.11 and 11.12
evidence_basis: Differences in organizational responsibilities monitoring coordination and accountability can limit consistent Green ICT implementation.

corrective_action: Introduce quantitative targets timelines and verification mechanisms.
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025; Renewable Energy Policy 2025
evidence_basis: Some Green ICT requirements need clearer quantitative targets timelines monitoring arrangements and verification mechanisms for measurable assessment.
